title.value: An Intentional Forgetting-Driven Self-Healing Method For Deep Reinforcement Learning Systems
title.justification: The title clearly states the subject of the paper, which involves a novel self-healing method for deep reinforcement learning systems using intentional forgetting.
title.quote: An Intentional Forgetting-Driven Self-Healing Method For Deep Reinforcement Learning Systems

extractions.description: This paper presents a self-healing approach called Dr. DRL for Deep Reinforcement Learning systems. It leverages intentional forgetting to enhance the adaptability and healing efficiency of DRL agents operating in environments with significant drifts. The method involves detecting behaviors with low relevancy and resetting them to prioritize major behaviors, thus optimizing plasticity and enhancing the system's self-healing capabilities.

climate_change_is_central.justification: The main focus of the paper is on improving the adaptability and healing process of deep reinforcement learning systems through intentional forgetting, without directly addressing climate change issues.
climate_change_is_central.quote: This paper, we propose Dr. DRL, a self-healing approach for DRL that leverages intentional forgetting combined with continual learning in order to optimize the agent’s plasticity and accelerate its adaptation to drifted environments.

primary_category.justification: The paper's focus is on a technical improvement in deep learning systems, specifically in deep reinforcement learning, without direct application or reference to climate change.
primary_category.quote: Deep reinforcement learning (DRL) is increasingly applied in large-scale productions like Netflix and Facebook.

secondary_categories.justification: No secondary category related to Climate Change is addressed in the paper.
secondary_categories.quote: Continual Learning (CL) is the inherent self-healing approach for adapting the DRL agent in response to the environment’s conditions shifts.

primary_sub_category.justification: The paper does not delve into topics of renewable energy, carbon reduction, or other identifiable climate change sub-categories.
primary_sub_category.quote: In this paper, we propose Dr. DRL, an effective self-healing approach for DRL systems that integrates a novel mechanism of intentional forgetting into vanilla CL (i.e., standard CL) to overcome its main issues.

secondary_sub_categories.justification: No secondary sub-category related to Climate Change is discussed in the paper.
secondary_sub_categories.quote: Dr. DRL deliberately erases the DRL system’s minor behaviors to systematically prioritize the adaptation of the key problemsolving skills.

applications.justification: The paper discusses the application of its proposed method, Dr. DRL, for self-healing in software production settings.
applications.quote: In this paper, we propose Dr. DRL, a self-healing approach for DRL that leverages intentional forgetting combined with continual learning in order to optimize the agent’s plasticity and accelerate its adaptation to drifted environments.
